description: Dataset of Georeferenced Dams in South America (DDSA) v1.0.2 is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Bolivar Eduardo Paredes-Beltran, Alvaro Sordo-Ward (Universidad Politecnica de Madrid, Universidad Tecnica de Ambato). Recommended citation Paredes-Beltran, B., Sordo-Ward, A., and Garrote, L.: Dataset of Georeferenced Dams in South America (DDSA), Earth Syst. Sci. Data, 13, 213–229, https://doi.org/10.5194/essd-13-213-2021, 2021. Coverage: continental; the metadata date the deposit to 2020. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
